item.title: North Korea Emphasizes 'Baekdu Mountain Spirit' on Guerrilla Founding Anniversary, Stressing 'Loyalty to the Leader' (北 ‘빨치산’ 창건일 ‘백두산 정신’ 계승 강조…“수령 결사옹위”)
item.description:
North Korea Emphasizes 'Baekdu Mountain Spirit' on Guerrilla Founding Anniversary, Stressing 'Loyalty to the Leader' (北 ‘빨치산’ 창건일 ‘백두산 정신’ 계승 강조…“수령 결사옹위”)

North Korea highlighted the 'Baekdu Mountain Spirit' and emphasized loyalty to State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un on the 94th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army, a anti-Japanese guerrilla force regarded as the root of the Korean People's Army. (북한은 인민군의 뿌리로 여기는 항일 빨치산(항일유격대) 조선인민혁명군 창건 94주년을 맞아 ‘백두산 정신’을 부각하며 김정은 국무위원장에 대한 충성을 강조했다.)

The Rodong Sinmun, the official newspaper of the Workers' Party, published an editorial on page 25 titled 'Carry Forward the Baekdu Mountain Spirit for Generations,' stating, "The fundamental core of the Baekdu Mountain Spirit created by anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners is the absolute defense of the leader," and adding, "We must faithfully uphold the ideology and leadership of respected Comrade Kim Jong-un." The newspaper said, "The succession of revolution is not a simple handover but a succession of the fighting spirit and a vigorous, throbbing, indomitable soul," and "A revolution sustained by ideological lineage and the blood of faith is eternally victorious and invincible." (노동당 기관지 노동신문은 25일 1면에 ‘백두산 정신을 만대에 이어나가자’라는 제목의 사설에서 “항일혁명선열들이 창조한 백두산 정신에서 근본핵은 수령결사옹위”라며 “경애하는 김정은 동지의 사상과 영도를 충직하게 받들어 나가야 한다”고 했다. 신문은 “혁명의 계승은 단순한 대물림이 아니라 투쟁정신의 계승, 힘차게 살아높뛰는 불굴의 넋의 계승”이라며 “사상의 혈통, 신념의 피로 이어지는 혁명은 영원히 필승불패”라고 했다.)

Baekdu Mountain is a symbolic site that North Korea promotes as the stage for Kim Il-sung's anti-Japanese struggle and the birthplace of Kim Jong-il. Kim Jong-un has visited Baekdu Mountain before making important decisions. He ascended Baekdu Mountain in February 2013, just before the execution of his uncle Jang Song-taek, and in October 2019, after the North Korea-U.S. nuclear talks ended without a deal, he rode a white horse up Baekdu Mountain and declared, "We will break through U.S. sanctions through self-reliance." (백두산은 북한이 김일성 주석의 항일 투쟁 무대, 김정일 국방위원장의 출생지로 선전하는 상징적 장소다. 김정은은 중요한 결단을 내리기 전에 백두산을 찾았다. 고모부 장성택 처형 직전 2013년 2월 백두산에 올랐고, 북미 핵협상이 노딜로 마무리 된 이후인 2019년 10월에는 백마 타고 백두산에 올라 “자력갱생으로 미국의 제재를 돌파하겠다”고 했다.)

The newspaper described the 'Baekdu Mountain Spirit' that day as "the firm conviction and will to uphold the great leader as the center of unity and leadership in the pioneering era of the revolution, while navigating the snowy trails of Baekdu," and as "an ideological and spiritual weapon to vigorously accelerate socialist construction through the power of single-hearted unity." It added, "We must make the tradition of loyalty and unity demonstrated by the first generation of revolutionaries an eternal bloodline and unite more tightly around the respected General Secretary to vigorously march toward new victories in the cause of the Juche revolution." (신문은 이날 ‘백두산 정신’은 “혁명의 개척기에 위대한 수령님을 단결의 중심, 영도의 중심으로 받들어 모시고 백두의 생눈길을 헤친 강인한 신념과 의지”라며 “일심단결의 위력으로 사회주의 건설을 힘있게 다그쳐나가게 하는 사상 정신적 무기”라고 했다. 그러면서 “혁명의 첫 세대들이 발휘한 충실성의 전통, 단결의 전통을 영원한 피줄기로 삼고 경애하는 총비서 동지의 두리에 더욱 철통같이 뭉쳐 주체혁명위업의 새 승리를 향하여 힘차게 나아가야 한다”고 했다.)

The Korean People's Revolutionary Army is the 'guerrilla force' organized by Kim Il-sung during his anti-Japanese activities in Manchuria. Since 1978, North Korea designated April 25, 1932, the founding date of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army, as the military founding anniversary. Although North Korea changed Armed Forces Day to February 8, the date of the regular army's founding, from 2018 onward, it still commemorates April 25 as the establishment of the first armed group, which became the precursor to the Korean People's Army. In 2022, on the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army—a milestone year divisible by 5 or 10—a large-scale military parade was held. (조선인민혁명군은 김일성이 만주에서 항일운동할 때 조직했다는 ‘빨치산’이다. 북한은 1978년부터 조선인민혁명군 창건일인 1932년 4월 25일을 군 창건 기념일로 지정했다. 2018년부터는 건군절을 정규군 창설일인 2월 8일로 바꿨지만, 4월 25일에 첫 무장단체가 창설돼 인민군의 모태가 됐다며 여전히 이날을 기념하고 있다. 조선인민혁명군 창건 90주년으로 정주년(5·10년 단위로 꺾어지는 해)이었던 2022년에는 대규모 열병식을 열었다.)

item.title: North Korea: Japan's Yasukuni Offering by Ishiba "Blatant Historical Distortion, Challenge to International Justice" (北, 日 다카이치 야스쿠니 공물에 “노골적 역사왜곡, 국제적 정의에 대한 도전”)
item.description:
North Korea: Japan's Yasukuni Offering by Ishiba "Blatant Historical Distortion, Challenge to International Justice" (北, 日 다카이치 야스쿠니 공물에 “노골적 역사왜곡, 국제적 정의에 대한 도전”)

North Korea has slammed Japanese Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba's offering of a ritual gift to Yasukuni Shrine and the collective visits by major politicians, calling it a "blatant distortion of history and a challenge to international justice and peace." (북한은 다카이치 사나에 일본 총리의 야스쿠니 신사 공물 봉납과 주요 정치인들의 집단 참배를 겨냥해 “노골적인 역사 왜곡이며 국제적인 정의와 평화에 대한 도전”이라고 했다.)

The Rodong Sinmun, the organ of the Workers' Party of Korea, said on the 25th that Yasukuni Shrine is "a place to pray for the souls of invaders and war criminals who inflicted unbearable misfortune and eternal, unhealable pain on other countries and peoples," and described visits to the shrine as "a touchstone for assessing Japan's attitude and stance toward its past history of aggression." It further claimed that the visits aim to "instill in the public consciousness the perception that war criminals are 'patriots' and that their unfulfilled 'will' must be realized at all costs." <<> The newspaper argued that this is "not about repentance for past evils, but about stirring up a spirit of revenge to create a social atmosphere conducive to militarization and the realization of re-aggression," asserting that such moves have become more blatant since the formation of the Ishiba cabinet. It added that "through visits to Yasukuni Shrine, they are tirelessly spreading militaristic ideology throughout society, while also desperately working to remove legal obstacles for shameless historical distortion and to assume the posture of a war-ready state through arms buildup," urging Japan to "engage in sincere reflection on its sinful past and move toward a path of repentance and correction, rather than chasing unrealizable dreams." <<> Prime Minister Ishiba offered a ritual gift to Tokyo's Yasukuni Shrine, which enshrines Class-A war criminals from the Pacific War, on the 21st. In addition to the prime minister, cabinet ministers and major politicians from the ruling coalition also made offerings or visited the shrine, with Minister of Economic Revitalization Minoru Kiuchi personally paying a visit. This marks the first confirmed case of a cabinet minister visiting the shrine since the Ishiba cabinet was formed in October last year. (노동당 기관지 노동신문은 25일 야스쿠니 신사가 “다른 나라와 민족들에게 참을 수 없는 불행과 영원히 아물 수 없는 고통을 준 침략자, 전범자들의 명복을 비는 곳”이라며 야스쿠니 신사 참배가 “일본이 과거 침략 역사를 대하는 태도와 입장을 평가하는 시금석”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “국민의 의식 속에 전범자들이야말로 ‘애국자’들이며 그들이 이루지 못한 ‘뜻’을 기어이 실현해야 한다는 인식을 심어주자는 데 목적이 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Jin-sook Won't Run for Daegu Mayor: "Won't Let the Conservative Heartland Fall to the Left" (이진숙, 대구시장 불출마 “보수 심장, 좌파에 못 넘긴다”)
item.description:
Lee Jin-sook Won't Run for Daegu Mayor: "Won't Let the Conservative Heartland Fall to the Left" (이진숙, 대구시장 불출마 “보수 심장, 좌파에 못 넘긴다”)

Lee Jin-sook, former chairwoman of the Korea Communications Commission, who was cut off (excluded from nomination) during the nomination process for the Daegu mayor candidate of the People Power Party, announced on the 25th that she would not run for Daegu mayor in the June 3 local elections. (국민의힘 대구시장 후보 경선 과정에서 컷오프(공천 배제)된 이진숙 전 방송통신위원장이 25일 6·3 지방선거에서 대구시장에 출마하지 않겠다고 밝혔다.)

At a press conference held at the People Power Party's Daegu city party headquarters that day, the former KCC chairwoman stated, "Today, I am stepping down from the position of preliminary candidate for Daegu mayor," adding, "Once the People Power Party's Daegu mayoral candidate is selected tomorrow (the 26th), I will lend my strength to ensure that candidate can defeat the Democratic Party candidate. I will protect Daegu from the reckless Democratic Party administration." (이 전 방송통신위원장은 이날 국민의힘 대구시당에서 기자회견을 열어 “오늘 저는 대구시장 예비후보라는 자리를 내려놓는다”며 “내일(26일) 국민의힘 대구시장 후보가 선출되면 그분이 민주당 후보를 이길 수 있도록 힘을 보태겠다. 대구를 무도한 민주당 정권으로부터 지켜내겠다”고 했다.)

Criticizing the nomination management committee's cutoff decision as unjust, the former chairwoman said, "I also had the intention of leaving the party and running as an independent to receive the judgment and choice of the citizens." She added, "If Daegu, too, falls to the left, what will become of South Korea? If the conservative red heart turns blue and the last bastion of liberal democracy is seized by socialist populism, what will become of South Korea? These concerns held me back." (이 전 위원장은 국민의힘 공천관리위원회의 컷오프 결정이 부당하다고 지적하면서 “탈당해 무소속으로 출마해서 시민들의 판단과 선택을 받겠다는 마음도 있었다”고 했다. 그러면서 “대구까지 좌파에게 넘어가면 대한민국이 어떻게 될 것인가. 보수의 붉은 심장이 파란색으로 물들고 자유민주주의 최후 보루가 사회주의 포퓰리즘에 장악된다면 대한민국은 어떻게 될 것인가 이런 우려가 저의 발목을 잡았다”고 했다.)

When asked whether she intended to run for the parliamentary by-election that could result from the People Power Party's Daegu mayoral election, the former chairwoman replied, "As I stated in my position statement, I have no other intention than to protect Daegu as the last bastion of liberal democracy." Asked if she had met with party leader Jang Dong-hyuk or other nomination committee members, she said, "Party leader Jang met with me before leaving for the U.S., and we recently met to discuss the Daegu issue." She added, "At that meeting, we discussed how to protect Daegu and reached a consensus." <<> Park Sung-hoon, senior spokesperson for the People Power Party, met with reporters at the National Assembly that day and stated, "We highly value the decision that the former chairwoman made after deep consideration for the party," adding, "We are confident that the former chairwoman's dedication and sacrifice will serve as a valuable foundation for victory in the Daegu mayoral election." Rep. Choo Kyoung-ho, a candidate in the People Power Party's Daegu mayoral runoff, said on Facebook, "I express deep respect for the former chairwoman's decision to willingly step down," adding, "Her decision has completed the united front of the liberal democratic camp." Rep. Yoo Young-ha also stated in a press release that day, "I respect the decision of candidate Lee Jin-sook," calling it "a weighty decision that went beyond personal political choice, considering the future of the party and Daegu together." He added, "Now we must put aside the time of conflict and competition and join forces as one." <<> The People Power Party plans to select its final candidate through a process combining voting by responsible party members (50%) and a poll of ordinary citizens (50%), pitting Rep. Choo Kyoung-ho against Rep. Yoo Young-ha, with the result to be announced on the 26th. Previously, on the 22nd of last month, the People Power Party's nomination management committee cut off Rep. Joo Ho-young and former KCC chairwoman Lee Jin-sook, who were both leading candidates for Daegu mayor. In response to the cutoff, Rep. Joo and the former chairwoman had hinted at the possibility of running as independents. Rep. Joo filed an injunction to suspend the effect of the cutoff, but after his application was dismissed in both the first trial and the appeal, he announced on the 23rd that he was giving up his bid for the Daegu mayoral election. (이 전 위원장은 국민의힘 대구시장 선거로 생길 수 있는 국회의원 보궐 선거 출마 의향이 있느냐는 질문에 “제 입장문에서 말씀드린 대로 대구를 자유민주주의 최후의 보루로 지키겠다는 그 마음밖에 없다”고 했다. 장동혁 당 대표나 다른 공관위원들과 만났느냐는 질문에는 “장 대표가 미국으로 떠나기 전 저를 만났고 최근에 만나서 대구 문제를 상의한 적이 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “그 자리에서 대구를 어떻게 지킬 것인가에 대한 논의가 있었고 또 공감대가 있었다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee says "Severe Punishment for Profiteering from Community Crisis" on Syringe Hoarding (李, 주사기 매점매석에 “공동체 위기 이용한 돈벌이 엄중 단죄”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 25th, "We will sternly punish such antisocial behavior that exploits the community's crisis, worsens the situation, and seeks profit." (이재명 대통령은 25일 “공동체의 위기를 이용해 위기를 악화시키며 돈벌이하는 이런 반사회적 행태는 엄중하게 단죄할 것”이라고 했다.)

On the same day, President Lee shared a news article on X (formerly Twitter) about health authorities busting multiple cases of syringe hoarding, and said, "In addition to continuous crackdowns, I have instructed the cabinet to take maximum post-facto measures, including swift investigations and severe penalties for detected violations, as well as the highest level of administrative sanctions." President Lee concluded his post with the words, "What's the fun in living well alone? Let's live together." (이 대통령은 이날 X(옛 트위터)에 보건 당국의 주사기 매점매석 무더기 적발 기사를 공유하고 “지속적 단속은 물론 발각된 위반 행위에 대해서는 신속한 수사와 엄벌, 최대치의 행정 제재 등 최대한의 사후 조치를 내각에 지시했다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “혼자 잘 살면 뭔 재민겨? 같이 삽시다”라고 글을 마무리했다.)

The Ministry of Food and Drug Safety conducted a special inspection of syringe sellers nationwide from the 20th for three days, resulting in the detection of 32 companies violating the hoarding prohibition notice. Among those caught, some companies had stockpiled approximately 130,000 syringes without selling them, or had supplied 620,000 syringes to specific clients—59 times the normal sales volume. (식약처는지난 20일부터 사흘간 전국 주사기 판매업체를 특별단속한 결과 매점매석금지고시를 위반한 업체 32개를 적발했다. 적발된 업체중에는 약 13만개 주사기를 쌓아두고도 판매하지 않거나 특정거래처에만 판매량의 59배에 달하는 62만개를 납품한 업체도 있었다.)

Earlier, the government announced a firm stance against market disruptions such as stockpiling, collusion, and supply manipulation, in response to concerns over unstable medical consumable supply chains amid the Middle East war. The Ministry of Food and Drug Safety is now conducting daily checks on companies' raw material holdings and production status, and has stepped up monitoring across all stages of production, demand, and distribution. The Fair Trade Commission plans to impose fines of up to 20% of related sales revenue for collusion, while the Ministry of Economy and Finance has launched a "National Supply Chain Difficulty Hotline" to address bottlenecks in import, production, and distribution processes caused by the Middle East conflict. (앞서 정부는 중동 전쟁 여파로 의료용 소모품 수급 불안이 우려되는 상황에 대응하기 위해 사재기와 담합, 출고 조절 등 시장 교란 행위에 대한 강경 대응 방침을 밝혔다. 식품의약품안전처는 기업의 원료 보유와 생산 상황을 매일 점검하고 생산·수요·유통 전 단계 점검 강화에 나선 상태다. 공정거래위원회는 담합에 대해 관련 매출액의 최대 20%에 이르는 과징금을 부과할 방침이고 재정경제부는 중동 전쟁으로 인한 수입·생산·유통 과정의 공급망 병목 현상을 해소하기 위해 ‘전 국민 공급망 애로 핫라인’을 가동 중이다.)

item.title: Opposition: "Korea-U.S. Alliance in Total Crisis"...Ruling Party: "Turning Foreign Policy and Security into Political Strife is an Act of Treason" (野 “한미동맹 총체적 난국”…與 “외교안보 정쟁화는 매국 행위” )
item.description:
On the 25th, People Power Party (PPP) Representative Jang Dong-hyuk shared on Facebook an article about National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac's briefing in Vietnam on the 23rd, where Wi stated he was "making efforts to manage the (Korea-U.S.) alliance relationship," and claimed that "the security office director has officially admitted that Korea-U.S. relations are 'abnormal.'" <<> Representative Jang called Wi's remarks "a candid confession that the Korea-U.S. alliance, the core axis of Korean Peninsula security, is wavering," adding that "yet he ultimately did not acknowledge the leak of classified information by Minister of National Defense Jeong." Jang asserted, "We cannot maintain the Korea-U.S. alliance by avoiding the problem. Restoring trust with the U.S. and dismissing Minister Jeong are the answers." <<> Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon also stated in a commentary, "After Minister Jeong carelessly exposed the location of a North Korean uranium facility, a secret of the Korea-U.S. alliance, the U.S. began restricting key information it had been providing to South Korea. This signifies the destruction of the most basic trust between allies." He further noted, "It is also shocking that diplomatic friction over the Coupang incident is blocking core security negotiations, such as nuclear submarine fuel supply and uranium enrichment authority," and urged "a complete overhaul of the foreign policy and security line that has fallen into total crisis." Spokesperson Ham In-kyung added, "Consecutive realities, including reduced sharing of key information, weakened alliance trust, and difficulties in major security negotiations, directly contradict the government's optimistic explanations. The government is merely repeating phrases like 'no problem' and 'it's being managed well,' even as abnormal signs in Korea-U.S. relations persist." <<> In response to the opposition's offensive, Democratic Party (DP) Deputy Floor Spokesperson Baek Seung-ah said in a written briefing, "The People Power Party is putting foreign policy and security issues at the forefront ahead of local elections, immersing itself in political strife. Using foreign policy and security as an election strategy goes beyond irresponsibility—it is an act of treason that damages national interests." Referring to Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's 8-night, 10-day trip to the U.S., she said, "Representative Jang has invited criticism for empty-handed diplomacy and even stated that the purpose of his visit to the U.S. was for the local elections. Isn't this reducing diplomacy to a tool for elections?" She added, "This is why even PPP candidates are turning their backs on Representative Jang and calling for his resignation. The DP will firmly oppose any foreign policy and security strife that damages national interests, and will protect national interests and the people through the practical diplomacy of the Lee Jae-myung administration." <<> Spokesperson Jang Yoon-mi also said in a written briefing, "The People Power Party is distorting the true intent of Director Wi Sung-lac's remarks, claiming he 'defined Korea-U.S. relations as abnormal,' and overlaying them with arbitrary interpretations. Fabricating statements he never made to take the rupture of the Korea-U.S. alliance for granted is a textbook example of outdated politics that sets aside security and focuses solely on political strife." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 25일 페이스북에 위성락 청와대 국가안보실장이 지난 23일 베트남에서 가진 브리핑에서 ‘(한미) 동맹 관계를 관리하려고 애를 쓰고 있다’고 한 내용의 기사를 공유하면서 “안보실장이 한미관계가 ‘비정상’임을 공식 인정했다”고 했다.)

item.title: Cho Gap-je: "Jang Dong-hyuk Keeps Deceiving the Public"... Jang: "Official Met in US Clearly an Assistant Secretary" (조갑제 “장동혁 계속 국민 속여”... 張 “방미 면단 인사 분명 차관보” )
item.description:
Conservative commentator Cho Gap-je, CEO of Cho Gap-je.com, said on the 25th, "Removing the Jang Dong-hyuk faction from the political arena is the only way to check the Democratic Party regime's rampage and protect national interests." (보수논객인 조갑제 조갑제닷컴 대표는 25일 “장동혁 세력을 정치판에서 제거하는 것이 민주당 정권의 폭주를 견제하고 국익을 지키는 유일한 길”이라고 했다.)

In a Facebook post that day, Cho said, "If a party cannot even take minimal self-rescue measures, like expelling Representative Jang Dong-hyuk for violating party constitution and rules—for leaving the election campaign, going to the US to have a good time, and then continuously deceiving the public about his activities—then voters have no choice but to dissolve the party through ballots." (조 대표는 이날 페이스북 글에서 “선거판을 이탈, 미국에 가서 잘 놀고 오더니 그 활동상에 대하여 계속 국민을 속임으로써 해당행위를 한 장동혁 대표를 당헌 당규 위반으로 제명하여 선거의 얼굴을 바꾸는 최소한의 자구조치도 할 수 없는 정당이라면 유권자들이 투표로 해산시키는 수밖에 없다”고 했다.)

Cho added, "The Democratic Party might be most saddened by losing its helper, but from the public's perspective, removing the Jang Dong-hyuk faction from politics is the only way to curb the Democratic Party regime's excesses and safeguard national interests." He continued, "If the control room of the conservative party is seized by a far-right cult group (pro-insurrection conspiracy theorists) and turns the course, which should head south, to the north, while the co-pilot (lawmakers) and passengers (party members) choose passive resistance, shouldn't we shoot down this hijacked plane to prevent a 9/11-like disaster? An egg that breaks itself becomes a chick, but an egg broken by others becomes an omelet and gets eaten." <<> Regarding criticism that he had inflated the title of a US State Department official he met during a recent trip—identified as the chief of staff to the assistant secretary for public diplomacy, not an assistant secretary—Representative Jang pushed back, saying, "The rank of that position is clearly that of an assistant secretary or higher." In a Facebook post, Jang stated, "If you check the US State Department website, there are exactly two people in public diplomacy leadership. The more you try to downplay diplomatic achievements by nitpicking titles, the more the public will focus on the diplomatic results." (조 대표는 “민주당이 도우미를 잃어 가장 아쉽게 생각하겠지만 국민들 입장에서는 장동혁 세력을 정치판에서 제거하는 것이 민주당 정권의 폭주를 견제하여 국익을 지키는 유일한 길”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “보수당의 조종실을 극우컬트 그룹(내란비호 음모론)이 장악, 남쪽으로 가야 할 항로를 북쪽으로 돌리는데도 부조종사(의원)와 승객들(당원)이 무저항을 선택한다면 납치된 이 여객기를 격추시켜 9·11 같은 피해를 예방해야 하는 것 아닌가”라며 “계란이 스스로를 깨면 병아리가 되지만 남이 깨면 계란 프라이가 되어 먹힌다”고 했다.)
